clauses.text:
1. Term of License
The Licensor hereby grants unto the Licensee the leave and license to occupy and use the Scheduled Premises for a fixed period of eleven (11) months commencing from 1st May 2026 to 31st March 2027.

2. Monthly Rent and Payment Date
The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor a monthly license fee (rent) of Rupees Eighteen Thousand (Rs. 18,000/-) per month. The monthly rent shall be payable in advance on or before the 5th day of each English calendar month directly into the Licensor's bank account.

3. Security Deposit and Deductions
The Licensee has deposited with the Licensor an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rupees Fifty Thousand (Rs. 50,000/-) upon signing this agreement. The Licensor shall be entitled to deduct from the security deposit all costs associated with repainting the premises, deep cleaning charges, pending utility bills, and any damage caused to fixtures and fittings.

4. Minimum Stay and Lock-in Period
4.1 The Licensee agrees to occupy the premises for the full agreed duration.
4.2 There shall be a strict lock-in period of six (6) months from the commencement date. If the Licensee vacates or terminates the license during this lock-in period, the Licensee shall remain liable to pay the balance rent for the remaining period of the lock-in.

5. Utilities and Maintenance Charges
The Licensee shall directly pay the electricity charges according to the meter reading, gas consumption bills, and internet charges. Society maintenance charges of Rs. 2,500 per month shall be paid by the Licensee along with the monthly rent.

6. Use and Subletting
The Scheduled Premises shall be used solely for private residential purposes by the Licensee. The Licensee shall not assign, sublet, underlet, or transfer the possession of the premises or any part thereof to any third party under any circumstances.

7. Notice of Termination
7.1 Clause 7.1: Subject to Clause 4.2, either party may terminate this agreement after the completion of the lock-in period by serving sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other party.

8. Right of Entry and Inspection
The Licensor and his authorised representatives shall be entitled to enter and inspect the Scheduled Premises at any time to verify the condition and maintenance of the property.

9. Early Vacating and Notice Requirements
9.1 The Licensee shall deliver vacant possession of the premises upon expiry of the license.
9.2 Any delay in handing over possession shall attract liquidated damages of Rs. 1,000 per day.
9.3 Clause 9.3: In the event the Licensee wishes to vacate the premises after the lock-in period, the Licensee shall provide one month's notice in writing to the Licensor.

10. Repairs, Upkeep, and Damage Liability
The Licensee shall be responsible for all repairs, replacement of bulbs, taps, fixtures, and day-to-day upkeep of the premises. Any loss, breakage, or damage occurring to the furniture, appliances, or walls during the period of occupation shall be borne entirely by the Licensee.

11. Rent Escalation and Renewal
If both parties mutually agree in writing to renew this license upon the expiry of the eleven-month term, the monthly rent shall automatically increase by five percent (5%) over the previous monthly rent for the renewed term.

12. Indemnity, Waiver, and Jurisdiction
The Licensee hereby agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Licensor against all claims, liabilities, damages, and legal costs arising from the Licensee's use of the Scheduled Premises. The Licensee unconditionally waives any right to dispute the deduction of damage repairs determined by the Licensor. Any dispute arising out of this agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent civil courts at Bengaluru.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have signed and executed this Leave and License Agreement on the date and year first hereinabove written.

LICENSOR:
Mr. Rajesh Sharma

LICENSEE:
Ms. Ananya Verma

Confirm deposit refund timeline in writing
Confirm lock-in period and early-exit terms
Confirm notice period required for termination
Get all agreed changes or clarifications in writing
Keep a fully signed copy of the final agreement
Get exact early-exit calculation or waiver confirmed in writing
Request written notice requirement (e.g. 24 hours) for landlord visits
Obtain receipt for security deposit payment
Take date-stamped photos of property condition and any existing damage
Record initial utility meter readings (electricity, water, gas)
Complete joint inventory check for furniture, fixtures, and appliances
